activity_summary: You played Gaunt at two. When the part was done you stayed in the house until the end. You did not go out to the street. Burbage kept the king. You came home after the play, on foot.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played Gaunt and did not leave early.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Kept the king through the afternoon.
